title: Visual impairment (combined acuity and field impairment)
summary: Visual impairment value of 1.00 or greater in the better eye, calculated by adding visual acuity impairment value and visual field impairment value.

rule_json.criterion: Visual impairment value of 1.00 or greater in the better eye (sum of visual acuity impairment value and visual field impairment value calculated per SSA formula)
